gloss: downtown; in town; the streets of a town

definitions.gloss: downtown; in town; the streets of a town
definitions.explanation: The busy, built-up part of a town or city where people and shops are, as opposed to the suburbs or the countryside.

examples.japanese: {街中|まちなか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
{街中|まちなか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧クマ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目撃|もくげき}→目撃：13627_mokugeki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A bear was spotted in the middle of town.

examples.japanese: {街中|まちなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦うるさい→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧。
examples.english: Living downtown is convenient, but the rent is high and it's a bit noisy.

notes:
Also written {町中|まちなか}. Do not confuse it with {街中|まちじゅう} (written the same way), which means "the whole town; all over town": {街中|まちじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (the whole town knows).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {街中|まちなか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk through town
- {街中|まちなか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}かける→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧: to see (someone) around town
- {街中|まちなか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喫茶店|きっさてん}→喫茶店：01079_kissaten⟧: a café in town

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{繁華街|はんかがい}→繁華街：09392_hankagai⟧: a busy shopping and entertainment district
- ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧: the center of a big city (especially Tokyo)
